title: Volkswagen Tiguan R-Line Discontinued In India
raw_summary: For a considerable amount of time, Volkswagen Tiguan R-Line stood tall as the brand’s flagship offering in the country. This 5-seater premium mid-size SUV was launched in India in April 2025 and it was imported into the country as a CBU (Completely Built Unit). Even though the company has not made any public announcements, Volkswagen Tiguan R-Line has now been discontinued from India and is de-listed from the official website. An official statement for this development is not released yet, but buyers looking for a premium mid-size SUV from VW can still look into Tayron.
summary: For a considerable amount of time, Volkswagen Tiguan R-Line stood tall as the brand’s flagship offering in the country. This 5-seater premium mid-size SUV was launched in India in April 2025 and it was imported into the country as a CBU (Completely Built Unit). Even though the company has not made any public announcements, Volkswagen Tiguan R-Line has now been discontinued from India and is de-listed from the official website.
article_paragraphs: For a considerable amount of time, Volkswagen Tiguan R-Line stood tall as the brand’s flagship offering in the country. This 5-seater premium mid-size SUV was launched in India in April 2025 and it was imported into the country as a CBU (Completely Built Unit).

Even though the company has not made any public announcements, Volkswagen Tiguan R-Line has now been discontinued from India and is de-listed from the official website. An official statement for this development is not released yet, but buyers looking for a premium mid-size SUV from VW can still look into Tayron.

Tiguan R-Line’s last recorded price tag was Rs 47.11 lakh (Ex-sh) and the company has now de-listed it from their official website, hinting at a possible discontinuation from the Indian market. Sold alongside the Tiguan R-Line was the slightly larger and more practical Tayron R-Line offering flexibility of three-row seating.

In terms of prices, Tayron R-Line is priced at Rs 47.74 lakh (Ex-sh), which is around the same price tag as Tiguan-R Line. Also, making a stronger case for Tayron R-Line was the fact that it was a locally assembled model brought into the country via CKD route (Completely Knocked Down) and assembled at their facility in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.

Because Tayron is a locally assembled model, Volkswagen also offers it in multiple variants and one of those variants is called Tayron Life, which is a 5-seater version of the 7-seater Tayron with more space in second row and then a larger boot. This 5-seater Tayron Life was priced at Rs 41.99 lakh (Ex-sh).

With Volkswagen Tiguan R-Line discontinued, the brand’s SUV portfolio for the Indian market has come down to two models – Taigun and Tayron. Taigun is the more affordable mass-market offering while Tayron is for buyers with aspirations to own a larger and a more premium mid-size SUV with a dash of performance and a host of features and technology.

The same 2.0L Turbo Petrol engine as Tayron R-Line also powered the Tiguan R-Line. This engine developed 201 bhp of peak power and 320 Nm of peak torque, mated to a sole 7-speed DSG transmission. Volkswagen’s 4MOTION AWD system was standard with Tiguan R Line.

raw_title: Is Trump About To Reignite His Big EV Push?
title: Is Trump About To Reignite His Big EV Push?
raw_summary: There are so many ironies with the Trump presidency. I remember writing about many of them in his first term. Now, though, we have some additional ones. For example, despite his apparent hate for clean technologies (wind power, solar power, electric vehicles, energy efficient appliances), Trump has pushed a ton of people to buy electric vehicles, including people who really wouldn’t consider doing so even with normal EV incentives in place. For example, despite his apparent hate for clean technologies (wind power, solar power, electric vehicles, energy efficient appliances), Trump has pushed a ton of people to buy electric vehicles, including people who really wouldn’t consider doing so even with normal EV incentives in place.

Of course, we all know what this is about. This was a key reason for the absolutely massive blue tsunami that took over the country this week. Trump’s war on Iran, which many Americans can’t explain in the slightest, drove gasoline prices up enormously and pushed people to go to the polls and vote Republican.

Trump and his team also knew this. They knew that the war on Iran was raising gas prices and that high gas prices are one of the worst things you can have when running for office. So, even though Trump didn’t leave himself any easy and simple way to get out of the war on Iran, he quieted down or paused his most significant actions against the country for the midterm elections and gas prices are not as high as they were a few months ago. They are just above $4/gallon on average , whereas the rose above $4.50/gallon earlier this year. Just in the week leading into election day, the national gas price average dropped by 12 cents a gallon . Of course, it was too little too late, and Republican politicians’ lack of concern for families and their high gas costs didn’t fare well in the election. This was probably the leading single factor for the swing to the left.

Now that the election is over and the war is not close to any resolution as far as we can tell, Trump may be inclined to heat it up again. If he has been holding back, he may go full force again into trying to force Iran to give in, and this could lead to a bigger closure of the Strait of Hormuz … which would likely lead to spiking gas prices again. Naturally, even at $4/gallon, Trump is making a lot of Americans ( and humans more broadly ) think about buying electric vehicles, and some of them are going to go ahead and making the switch. What if Trump goes further, as many now expect he will, and oil supply is disrupted much worse and oil prices spike again? He could become one of the greatest EV salesmen in history. We’ll see what happens….

The total premium includes different charges, depending on the coverage selected. Understanding these components helps you compare car insurance options and see where your money goes. Depending on the policy, it can include:
Third-party cover: This pays for covered liability towards other people or their property. Its base premium follows prescribed rates for the vehicle category.
Own-damage cover: This protects your car against insured events such as accidents, theft and fire. The amount depends on the vehicle and the cover selected.
Optional add-ons: Covers such as zero depreciation or engine protection increase the premium when selected.
A quote shows the proposed amount before purchase. The tax invoice records the amount charged after the policy is issued. Keep both documents.
A higher bill does not always mean the tax has increased. Check what changed since your previous policy.

title: NRDC Assessment of BAAJA, the 2026 Permitting & Transmission Bill
raw_summary: The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA) is the result of years of negotiations on permitting reform. The product is a bill that combines critically important transmission and grid reforms with significant and concerning changes to federal environmental laws, permitting standards, and judicial remedies. The transmission provisions in the bill would produce substantial and durable benefits, updating an aging power grid by allowing new investments. These reforms, which NRDC has long supported, are an essential component of accelerating the electrification and decarbonization of the power sector and achieving greenhouse gas reduction targets. On their own, these changes are much needed and overdue; they would also help any future clean energy incentives and standards succeed in cutting emissions. But transmission is an enabling technology rather than a substitute for policies that directly drive clean energy investment and reduce pollution.
summary: The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA) is the result of years of negotiations on permitting reform. The product is a bill that combines critically important transmission and grid reforms with significant and concerning changes to federal environmental laws, permitting standards, and judicial remedies.
article_paragraphs: The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA) is the result of years of negotiations on permitting reform. The product is a bill that combines critically important transmission and grid reforms with significant and concerning changes to federal environmental laws, permitting standards, and judicial remedies.

The transmission provisions in the bill would produce substantial and durable benefits, updating an aging power grid by allowing new investments. These reforms, which NRDC has long supported, are an essential component of accelerating the electrification and decarbonization of the power sector and achieving greenhouse gas reduction targets. On their own, these changes are much needed and overdue; they would also help any future clean energy incentives and standards succeed in cutting emissions. But transmission is an enabling technology rather than a substitute for policies that directly drive clean energy investment and reduce pollution.

However, there are a number of concerning provisions that raise substantial issues and reinforce the position of incumbent energy interests. The “project certainty” language is designed to ensure projects cannot be arbitrarily canceled. As drafted, it could benefit fossil fuel, mining, data center, and other industrial projects more than clean energy. It could also limit agencies’ ability to address newly discovered harms, constrain future pollution regulation, and create large taxpayer-funded corporate handouts.

The bill would also weaken key elements of core environmental laws, including the Clean Water Act (CWA), the Endangered Species Act, the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), and the National Historic Preservation Act (NHPA). The bill would narrow environmental review across those statutes, diminish state and Tribal authority, constrain public participation, and restrict courts’ ability to stop projects proceeding under unlawful permits. These changes erode fundamental protections for communities.

The backdrop, of course, is the Trump administration’s nonstop attacks on clean energy projects, tax incentives for clean energy, and climate standards. NRDC’s analysis finds in aggregate that the Trump administration’s actions could double carbon emissions from the power sector over the next decade while raising consumers’ electric utility bills by $30 billion per year by 2035. Lawmakers should push for tangible evidence that this has changed before voting on the legislation.

While NRDC is encouraged by the transmission provisions, other elements of the bill are deeply flawed. We will be seeking improvements in the coming weeks and will take a position on the bill before a floor vote.
Below is an assessment of the most positive and most negative elements of the bill. This is not intended to be comprehensive.

An aging power grid desperately needs updating, and with more extreme weather and surging demand from data centers, getting new electricity connected to the grid quickly is essential to keeping energy costs down and maintaining resilience. In one fell swoop, this legislation would address these issues, producing the necessary conditions to deploy more clean energy.

raw_title: Toyota Innova Hycross & Hyryder Hybrids Set New Records For Elevation Gains
title: Toyota Innova Hycross & Hyryder Hybrids Set New Records For Elevation Gains
raw_summary: GaadiWaadi - Innova Hycross completed a high altitude drive in under a day while the Urban Cruiser Hyryder achieved a separate record on one tank of petrol Toyota Kirloskar Motor has secured two Asia Book of Records titles after the Innova Hycross and Urban Cruiser Hyryder completed a journey from West Bengal to Sikkim. The Innova Hycross attained an altitude of 4,310 metres in 22 hours 52 minutes meeting the 24-hour requirement for its record category. The Urban Cruiser Hyryder arrived at the same destination on a single tank of petrol. The two vehicles use different petrol-electric hybrid systems. The Innova Hycross has a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine coupled with Toyota’s fifth generation hybrid technology producing a combined power output of 183.7 hp. The Urban Cruiser Hyryder uses a smaller 1.5-litre petrol engine and an electric motor generating around 114 hp. Both vehicles employ an electronically controlled automatic transmission but their engine capacities and electrical components differ. The Innova Hycross received recognition for the maximum elevation gained by a car within 24 hours. The Hyryder secured a separate title for the highest elevation gained on one tank of fuel. The latter achievement concerns the ability to complete the specified ascent without refuelling – not a measured fuel-economy record. Both results were recognised by the Asia Book of Records following the respective driving challenges. The journey began at Mandarmani in West Bengal, just two metres above sea level before ending at Nathula Pass in Sikkim at 4,310 metres. The vehicles encountered coastal roads, national highways and mountainous sections on their way to the Himalayan destination. The considerable altitude difference also meant changes in road gradients, temperatures and atmospheric conditions. The two record categories placed separate requirements on the vehicles despite their common destination. The Innova Hycross Hybrid has an ARAI-certified fuel economy figure of 23.24 kmpl and a 52-litre petrol tank. The Urban Cruiser Hyryder Hybrid returns a certified 27.97 kmpl and carries a 45-litre fuel tank. The Hyryder has the advantage in certified fuel efficiency but those laboratory figures do not establish the consumption recorded on the mountain journey. However, the actual distance travelled and petrol used on the record attempt have not been specified. The petrol-electric systems can operate using the combustion engine, electric motor or a combination of both based on driving conditions. Regenerative braking recovers energy when the vehicle slows down and the petrol engine can also recharge the hybrid battery. Neither vehicle requires an external charging connection. The electric motors assist the petrol engines when required and the automatic hybrid systems manage the power sources without manual intervention from the driver.

raw_summary: At the time of its launch in India, the BMW F 450 GS was offered in three variants – Base, Exclusive and GS Trophy. BMW is offering the F 450 GS Sport variant in an exclusive Racing Red colour option. This colourway predominantly combines shades of dark red and black, along with white and grey. With this new colour, the bike is now available with three colour options. The base and Exclusive variants are available in Cosmic Black colour. The GS Trophy variant is available in Racing Blue Metallic colour.

F 450 GS Sport is essentially the GS Trophy, without the Easy Ride Clutch (ERC), which is available exclusively with the GS Trophy variant. Among enthusiasts planning to buy the BMW F 450 GS, the priorities can be broadly classified into ‘with ERC’ and ‘without ERC’. For the latter group, the new Sport variant ensures that all other features are accessible including the adjustable suspension.

Sport variant’s Racing Red paintwork creates an exciting contrast and complements the bike’s sporty profile. Sharp design elements of the bike are better accentuated with this new colourway. The red shade is used largely across the front cowl, fuel tank and rear side panels. Rest of the surfaces are mostly black. The Sport variant also has distinctive graphics, combining themes in white and black.

This paintwork also does a good job at accommodating the gold-finished USD forks. Coming to equipment, the new Sport variant of BMW F 450 GS has sport suspension, Gear Shift Assistant Pro, offroad footrests, clear windshield and hand protection. The Sport variant also has Riding Modes Pro (+Enduro Pro). As is evident, the Sport variant has most of the features available with the top-spec GS Trophy variant.

Powering the F 450 GS is a 420cc twin-cylinder engine that produces 48 hp and 43 Nm of torque, paired with a 6-speed transmission. Ride modes include Rain, Road and Enduro. The bike uses a steel tube frame with the engine as a stressed member, along with a steel tube sub-frame. Suspension is 43 mm USD forks at the front and a monoshock at the rear. It rides on cast aluminium wheels, with disc brakes at both ends and ABS Pro.

Key features include ride-by-wire, an anti-hopping clutch, dynamic traction control (DTC) and dynamic engine brake control (MSR). The tech kit includes a 6.5-inch colour TFT instrument display, and there are heated grips, a Type C USB port and Bluetooth connectivity. You also get one key for all the locks, an adjustable foot brake lever, an on-board computer, and adjustable clutch and handbrake levers.

title: Crate Engine: A 508 BHP Chevrolet 383 Stroker V8
raw_summary: This is a 383 stroker V8 crate engine from the team at The Hot Rod Company, it’s rated at 508 bhp and it was developed for street-driven muscle cars, hot rods, trucks, and other automotive applications that favor plenty of torque low in the rev-range. Each engine comes with a two year warranty, and they’re built in the United States by hand at the company’s 17,000 square foot facility in Washington State, not far from the Montana border.

article_paragraphs: This is a 383 stroker V8 crate engine from the team at The Hot Rod Company, it’s rated at 508 bhp and it was developed for street-driven muscle cars, hot rods, trucks, and other automotive applications that favor plenty of torque low in the rev-range.
Each engine comes with a two year warranty, and they’re built in the United States by hand at the company’s 17,000 square foot facility in Washington State, not far from the Montana border.

This is the Chevrolet 383 Stroker V8 crate engine built by Hot Rod Company of Greenacres, Washington. It turns out 508 bhp and it was developed for street-driven muscle cars, hot rods, and modified trucks, with a focus on excellent low-end torque and usable performance, rather than high-rpm bragging rights.

The Hot Rod Company is a high-performance crate engine builder based out of Spokane Valley, Washington. It specializes in small-block and LS-based Chevrolet V8s, and it was co-founded by JR and Katie Roby.

The Robys say they started the business in 2006, while budgeting for their wedding and trying to stay out of debt. JR listed an engine from one of his race cars on Craigslist for $5,000, and it sold within a day. “And the phone kept ringing and ringing,” he later recalled in a 2023 interview.

He told Katie that if the calls continued he would say the engine was for sale and build another , and within the hour he said yes to the next caller. People kept calling about the original listing for days after, and it became very clear that there was an untapped market for good quality crate engines.

JR grew up in Salem, Oregon, where his after-school chores included stripping and building engines and transmissions with his father. He started drag racing at 16, and later while working as a personal trainer, he was sponsored by 24 Hour Fitness, which gave him a drag car and $30,000 a year to compete. He moved to Spokane in 2002 to help open one of the chain’s gyms.

The company has a policy that each engine is built by a single person, and that person signs the block when it’s done. A build takes about two days on average, but it can take longer for more complex builds. JR notes that the company has had warranty issues on fewer than 1% of their builds, a figure he credits partly to the one-builder approach.

title: Mahindra To Launch 3 New Cars By June 2027
raw_summary: During its Q2 FY27 results media briefing, Mahindra Automotive Sector CEO, Rajesh Jejurikar, announced three launches in the first half of 2027. While names have not been revealed, these new launches could include the Vision S-based SUV (speculated to be Sub 4m Scorpio Sport), BE 07 and Scorpio Lifestyler pickup. Mahindra will also introduce updates to an existing model and launch a new light commercial vehicle by June 2027. Production version of the Vision S concept will be the first SUV based on Mahindra’s NU_IQ platform. This versatile platform is future-ready, with support for petrol, diesel, hybrid and fully electric powertrains. Test mules of Vision S have been frequently spotted and launch is expected by Q1, 2027. This will be a sub-4-meter SUV, likely positioned above the XUV 3XO in the company’s lineup.

Mahindra recently filed a design patent for the Vision S SUV. Key features include boxy proportions, an upright front fascia, distinctive lighting signatures, squared wheel arches, flush door handles, muscular body panelling and a tailgate-mounted spare wheel. Higher trims will get premium features like a panoramic sunroof, ventilated seats, wireless charging, Level-2 ADAS and a 360° camera setup.

Mahindra’s born-electric INGLO platform currently has three EVs – BE 6, XEV 9e and XEV 9S. This range will be expanded with BE 07, which is expected to be launched by Q1, 2027. Test mules have revealed exciting features such as frameless doors and pop-out flush door handles. BE 07 has a sharp, angular silhouette, ensuring a striking presence.

Key features expected with BE 07 include a digital IRVM, a triple screen layout, ventilated seats, immersive ambient lighting, premium audio system and auto parking. Connectivity functions will be powered by Adrenox and the SUV will have Level-2+ ADAS. Battery pack options could include 59 kWh and 79 kWh units, borrowed from BE 6. Mahindra BE 07 will take on rivals like Harrier EV, BYD Atto 3 and Vinfast VF7.

Another potential bestseller in the making, Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler can give tough competition to rivals like Toyota Hilux and Isuzu D-Max V-Cross. Scorpio Lifestyler is the production version of the Global Pik Up concept unveiled in 2023. In addition to the domestic market, the Lifestyler pickup will be sold in multiple global markets.

Users can expect robust performance with the Lifestyler, as it’s built on the same ladder frame chassis as the Scorpio N SUV. Powertrain options for the Lifestyler are also expected to be the same as the Scorpio N SUV. Scorpio Lifestyler will be competitively priced, with Mahindra already announcing that the pickup’s starting price will be below Rs 19.79 lakh (ex-sh).

To meet growing demand for its SUVs and EVs, Mahindra will be increasing production. Rajesh Jejurikar, Executive Director and CEO (Auto and Farm Sector) at Mahindra, said that the company is already operating above its full production capacity. Current production capacity (SUV + EV) is at 68,000 units per month, as of September 2026.

title: Amazon set to deploy more than 3,000 TATA electric delivery trucks
raw_summary: Amazon isn’t just electrifying its American delivery operations. The virtual big box stores that Bezos built understands the benefits of EVs as well as anyone, and they’re working hard to deploy electric vehicles everywhere they can . And now, that global push is extending to India. Indian automaker TATA Motors has announced a deal with Amazon to deploy 3,000 electric trucks across Amazon’s transportation network in India . When it goes live, it will be the largest electric truck deployment by in India and mark Amazon’s most significant move to extend its Indian fleet electrification beyond last-mile logistics.
summary: Amazon isn’t just electrifying its American delivery operations. The virtual big box stores that Bezos built understands the benefits of EVs as well as anyone, and they’re working hard to deploy electric vehicles everywhere they can . And now, that global push is extending to India.
article_paragraphs: Amazon isn’t just electrifying its American delivery operations. The virtual big box stores that Bezos built understands the benefits of EVs as well as anyone, and they’re working hard to deploy electric vehicles everywhere they can . And now, that global push is extending to India.

Indian automaker TATA Motors has announced a deal with Amazon to deploy 3,000 electric trucks across Amazon’s transportation network in India . When it goes live, it will be the largest electric truck deployment by in India and mark Amazon’s most significant move to extend its Indian fleet electrification beyond last-mile logistics.

“India is accelerating towards electric mobility and the realization of Viksit Bharat 2047,” says Shri H.D. Kumaraswamy, Hon’ble Union Minister for Heavy Industries and Steel, Government of India. “The collaboration between TATA Motors and Amazon shows what that looks like in practice: sustained demand from a nationwide logistics network met by electric trucks manufactured in India. Through PM E-DRIVE, the Government will continue to support this transition, and I look forward to more such efforts in powering green logistics.”

In addition to being a big deal for TATA, the 3,000 electric truck deal represents a serous bump to India’s deployed electric truck fleet, and are a major step towards the wide-scale electrification of freight transportation across the country – that’s not just good for Amazon’s fuel bills, it’s good for everyone and everything that breathes air, too.

“ Electrifying our logistics and transportation network is an important part of Amazon’s goal to achieve net-zero carbon emissions by 2040 ,” says Abhinav Singh, Vice President, Operations, Amazon, APAC, Middle East, Africa and Turkey. “We have made significant progress in India, with more than 15,000 electric vehicles operating across 500-plus cities . To enable this transition, we are also supporting the development of infrastructure and solutions that make EV adoption easier for our carrier partners and drivers. We are now setting a bold vision to scale electric trucking , addressing one of the toughest challenges in decarbonizing transportation. Our collaboration with TATA Motors marks an important step towards realizing this vision. By combining our strengths, we aim to accelerate the deployment of electric trucks across more routes, starting with intracity operations and expanding to India’s major freight corridors.”

The truck Amazon will be deploying in these record numbers is a version of the Tata Ultra E.7, a 7.5-tonne (~16,000 lb.) straight truck powered by a 240 kW (~320 hp) electric motor drawing power from a 96 kWh LFP battery pack. The truck’s makers claim a loaded range of up to 130 km (~80 miles) on a single charge, with DC fast-charging that’s capable enough to keep the trucks charged up between deliveries.
Amazon’s new TATA electric delivery trucks will support the transport of goods between warehouse facilities – which means traveling across cities and along India’s national freight corridors.

title: Tampa Community Turns Out for Sierra Club's 'Power & Perspectives: The Energy Dialogue
raw_summary: TAMPA, Fla. — On Thursday, November 5, Sierra Club Florida and partner organizations hosted “ Power & Perspectives: The Energy Dialogue ,” a community town hall addressing TECO bill increases and the need for local utility accountability. Over 25 people attended the event featuring a panel of Sierra Club, Food & Water Watch, and Hillsborough Affordable Energy Coalition representatives, as well as a member of Tampa’s City Council and the city’s Sustainability & Resilience Officer. TECO has recently boasted rate decreases, however, monthly bills for residential or small business customers using 1,000 kWh per month are still over $10 higher than in December 2024. While families contend with higher bills, the CEO of TECO made $2.5 million last year. The CEO of Emera, TECO’s parent company, made $9.5 million.

article_paragraphs: TAMPA, Fla. — On Thursday, November 5, Sierra Club Florida and partner organizations hosted “ Power & Perspectives: The Energy Dialogue ,” a community town hall addressing TECO bill increases and the need for local utility accountability. Over 25 people attended the event featuring a panel of Sierra Club, Food & Water Watch, and Hillsborough Affordable Energy Coalition representatives, as well as a member of Tampa’s City Council and the city’s Sustainability & Resilience Officer.

TECO has recently boasted rate decreases, however, monthly bills for residential or small business customers using 1,000 kWh per month are still over $10 higher than in December 2024. While families contend with higher bills, the CEO of TECO made $2.5 million last year. The CEO of Emera, TECO’s parent company, made $9.5 million.

“Transparency shouldn’t be optional when families are forced to choose between keeping the lights on and buying groceries,” said Walter Smith II, Sierra Club’s Tampa Bay Organizing Representative . “We invited our neighbors, TECO reps, and environmental justice experts into the same room because the community deserves answers about their energy burdens and the various impacts of fossil fuels on our environment and health. This town hall is a critical first step toward demanding a just, affordable, and clean energy future for everyone in Tampa Bay.”

“Tampa residents have been struggling under the weight of skyrocketing electricity bills, all while Tampa Electric walks away with record profits year after year and passes the costs of fuel, storm recovery, and even its brand new Midtown headquarters onto ratepayers,” said Isabella Moeller, Florida Organizer for Food & Water . “But our community has had enough. TECO is a for-profit company beholden to shareholders only, that’s why we’re making a wide call to our local elected officials to hold TECO and its regulators accountable to the people they serve. Tampa City Council has an opportunity to pass an affordable energy resolution that commits the city to opposing TECO’s unjust rate hikes and supporting clean, affordable energy solutions. We must build on this momentum and ensure that affordable energy is a priority for every elected official in Tampa.”

raw_title: Winners & losers from F1 2026 Brazilian GP Friday practice
title: Winners & losers from F1 2026 Brazilian GP Friday practice
raw_summary: A familiar name at the top of the timesheet, but not your run of the mill F1 Friday at the Brazilian Grand Prix, as one struggling frontrunner got back in the groove again while the usual kings of Friday practice produced their worst result of the season. Here are our winners and losers from the first day of F1 track action at Interlagos.
summary: A familiar name at the top of the timesheet, but not your run of the mill F1 Friday at the Brazilian Grand Prix, as one struggling frontrunner got back in the groove again while the usual kings of Friday practice produced their worst result of the season.
article_paragraphs: A familiar name at the top of the timesheet, but not your run of the mill F1 Friday at the Brazilian Grand Prix, as one struggling frontrunner got back in the groove again while the usual kings of Friday practice produced their worst result of the season.
Here are our winners and losers from the first day of F1 track action at Interlagos.

Charles Leclerc and Ferrari had been fastest in Friday practice at three of the past four races, going back to October’s Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, and a 6-7 FP2 result in Brazil (with Leclerc behind Lewis Hamilton) was the first time all season Ferrari has finished Friday outside the top five on the timesheet. Leclerc called it a “very, very difficult Friday” and described the feeling inside the car as “strange” and “very poor”. “We were losing in the straights, but I think the car in the corners just felt probably one of the worst Friday feelings of the season," he added. “So I think there's a lot to be found in corners, more than in the straights, where we know we have a deficit. Normally we are very fast in corners and today was not the case.” Team boss Fred Vasseur joked this was a Friday when Ferrari “have 200 kilos” of fuel inside the cars in order to flip the script, such is their usually prodigious form in free practice, but in a serious moment then admitted Ferrari has “a lot of work to do on the balance”. “The drivers, they were not happy,” he confirmed, while also saying he was “not less optimistic than last week” when Leclerc topped Friday in Mexico. “We had a couple of times a deployment issue in the lap,” Vasseur added. “We have to fine-tune everything. “On his fastest lap, he [Leclerc] lost a couple of tenths in a straight line. I would say that it’s not a drama. It’s more for you [the media] to be focused on page one [of the timing screen], but we are not. “We know that we have a lot to do on the balance. The balance was not good. The tarmac is the opposite of one week ago. It’s creating a lot of work to do and a difference compared to last week.” - Ben Anderson

Fastest in FP1 and looking competitive on longer runs - McLaren's upgrade package for Brazil appears to be working well, with the usual caveat that Fridays don't always offer perfect insight into the order. Senior racing director Randy Singh said it's "very likely" the upgrades - led by a new front wing - will stay on the car, and Friday went "really well" for the team, while Lando Norris cautioned that the team still looks two-tenths off Kimi Antonelli's Mercedes but "pretty good" compared to the other teams.
Norris also felt gently encouraged that McLaren's new 2027-ethos front wing had begun to address the long-standing edginess of the car's balance.
"I would say maybe there’s a small change in the right direction, that it seems just a little bit more straightforward to drive," he said.

"I don’t think we can ever judge things over just one track. But so far, for today, things have seemed a little bit more straightforward." After missing FP1, Singh says Oscar Piastri was also "immediately on the pace" - something which hasn't always happened this year - but the usual rule from recent races applies: the team needs to optimise qualifying, where its knife-edge car has let its long-run pace down all too often. - Jack Benyon

Every now and then, a lesser-known Friday driver pops up high on the timesheets in an FP1 outing, which is exactly what Gabriele Mini did on his second appearance for Alpine by setting the seventh-fastest time to head the midfield pack.

raw_title: ‘Dangerous’ but also ‘brilliant’
title: Dangerous' but also 'brilliant
raw_summary: New Haas driver Rafa Camara received a reprimand on his Formula 1 debut for what was deemed “clearly dangerous” impeding of Charles Leclerc in Brazilian Grand Prix practice. Camara weaved and moved into the racing line as he prepared to start a push lap in FP2 at Interlagos just as Leclerc was coming by to complete a lap of his own.
summary: New Haas driver Rafa Camara received a reprimand on his Formula 1 debut for what was deemed “clearly dangerous” impeding of Charles Leclerc in Brazilian Grand Prix practice. Camara weaved and moved into the racing line as he prepared to start a push lap in FP2 at Interlagos just as Leclerc was coming by to complete a lap of his own.
article_paragraphs: New Haas driver Rafa Camara received a reprimand on his Formula 1 debut for what was deemed “clearly dangerous” impeding of Charles Leclerc in Brazilian Grand Prix practice.
Camara weaved and moved into the racing line as he prepared to start a push lap in FP2 at Interlagos just as Leclerc was coming by to complete a lap of his own.

Though he was warned several times that Leclerc was approaching, Camara ended up squeezing the Ferrari towards the run-off at high speed “with a significant amount of the car off the track”, said the stewards, who upgraded the typical practice penalty for impeding from a warning to a formal reprimand.
“The situation that was created was clearly dangerous and [Camara] should have taken more care to avoid impeding [Leclerc]."
Camara’s incident with Leclerc was a blot on an otherwise solid and steadily improving first day in the car.

He finished 0.86s slower than Ollie Bearman in FP1, and trimmed the gap to 0.57s in FP2, with the biggest part of his time lost in the middle sector - although he had been even closer on the initial hard-tyre push laps before switching to softs.
There was a recurring problem under braking into Turn 1, where Camara had huge run-ending lock-ups in both FP1 and FP2, although several drivers had trouble here.
And he was still trying to smoothen his throttle usage exiting Turns 2 and 12 by the end of Friday as well.
